status: Asset review only; not integrated into application
generation: Built-in image generation; reconstructed artwork, not recovered source layers
alignment: All images share the same full-canvas origin. Do not individually trim.
movementPreparation: For implementation, render stack with 6% overscan per side; keep shifts within 3% horizontal and 2% vertical. Plates are not tileable; use slow reversing drift, not wraparound.
limitations: Flattened screenshot cannot reveal hidden terrain or original alpha. These plates reconstruct the palette and valley composition, not exact source geometry. Static preview uses the listed layer opacities. No animation or responsive crops have been implemented.

assets.name: sky
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: clean sky base plate for a layered website landscape. Image 1 is the approved visual reference, not content to copy. Generate exactly ONE image, a 1536 x 1024 landscape canvas. Reconstruct ONLY its delicate warm off-white cream sky, slight pale lavender-gray atmospheric tint toward left and upper edges, very restrained warm ivory light low right of center. Completely remove ALL typography, logo, nav, buttons, company logos, dots, lines, mountains, trees, clouds and UI. No objects, no visible sun, no shapes, no hard gradient banding. This is the bottom opaque background plate: soft natural atmospheric illumination, mostly #FAF9F6, not pink or saturated. Full bleed to all four edges, no borders. Preserve the reference's airy understated premium feeling. Output only the sky image, not a mockup or contact sheet.

No middle/foreground mountains, no trees, no clouds, no sun, no text/UI/branding, no decorative lines/dots. This is a clean isolated distant terrain plate, not a whole finished landscape. Preserve reference color mood and central open valley. Use transparency for all sky and soft antialiased ridge edges.
